name: photo-marquee
purpose: The office band of the careers page: a horizontal section title over a framed strip of photographs of varied aspect ratios that scrolls continuously and pauses on hover or focus. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'photo-marquee', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title` and `frame-box`.
useWhen: To show a place or a team in pictures without a grid.
related: recognition-marquee` — the sibling strip of quotes with the same loop.
bestPractices: Give every photo its `width` and `height` so the strip reserves each slot before the picture loads.
Leave `duration` at `0` to let the strip pace itself (ten seconds per photo).

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: descriptionWidth
props.doc: Width the description is capped at: `narrow` or `wide`.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the scrolling region.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Seconds one loop of the strip takes; `0` paces it at ten seconds per photo.

props.name: photos
props.doc: The photographs, in order; each is `{ src, alt, width, height }`.

examples.name: Default
